items.title: Trump’s Stock Disclosure Shows More Than 1,000 Trades in June
items.summary: President Donald Trump made more than 1,000 securities trades in June, including significant purchases of Berkshire Hathaway Inc., Visa Inc., Mastercard Inc. and Cintas Corp., according to a financial disclosure published Saturday.

items.title: Visa (V) Backs New Standards For Agentic Payments
items.summary: Visa (NYSE: V) has joined the newly formed Agentic Payments Alliance to help set standards for autonomous and agent driven commerce. The Alliance brings together Visa, Mastercard, Fiserv, Circle and Solana to work on common rules for agent authorization, fraud detection and loyalty integration. The group also aims to coordinate industry input on regulation at a time when federal guidance on agentic payments remains unclear.
